text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I rush Mayano Top Gun to the infirmary after she hurts herself during training.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, owwww! This injury's gonna keep me grounded for a while…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I know…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I'll be in even better shape than before with you around to nurse me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Eeeee! ☆ Yay!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Okay! First thing's first, you have to take my temperature…
choice_data_list: Take your temperature? You're injured, not sick.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Don't sweat the small stuff! My heart's gonna beat so hard that it zooms right outta my chest—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Urk!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: H-huh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: That… really hurt, I think…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun gets a bit carried away with her roleplay. I look after her until she's back to normal.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Huh?! No way! This is how grown-ups show affection!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Weird… The book said that this method would be a total killer… ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh! Maybe it's because I don't have a fever! Maybe if I give myself one, it'll work out just like—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmgrgh… Fiiine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mayano Top Gun seems a bit disheartened, but she manages to get enough rest…

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: …Don't tell me you're not the type to swoon over something like this.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Well then, what do you like, Trainer? What can I do to make your heart skip a beat?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: My health? So you're saying that me being healthy makes you happy?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: What?! Really?! Are you serious?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! Then I'll rest a ton and get right back on my feet!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: And then, and then! We can train together again. ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just as she promised, Mayano Top Gun gets some proper rest and resumes her training in good health.
